method: Primary agency pages and indexed primary material; source claims are self-reported and not independently verified.

evidence_tiers.A: Explicit primary React web-app association with relevant named application/case
evidence_tiers.B: React/application service evidence; exact app fit pending

leads.name: HELLO PEOPLE
leads.observed_evidence: React service page describes a multi-location analytics dashboard with live sales and inventory views.
leads.next_qualification: Confirm an upcoming React app handover, test access and who owns existing QA.

leads.name: Squash Apps
leads.observed_evidence: Hydesq project description includes a React admin dashboard, floor plans, booking management and utilization reports.
leads.next_qualification: Ask about agency handover checks on web dashboards; exclude the React Native employee app.

leads.name: Muthu Creatives
leads.observed_evidence: Apex Analytics portfolio page explicitly lists React/TypeScript and live role-based dashboard views.
leads.next_qualification: Founder-led delivery is stated; verify client/project authenticity and current application work rather than marketing websites.

leads.name: Vyarah
leads.observed_evidence: Analytics case page describes a React frontend using Recharts, virtualized tables and WebSocket updates.
leads.next_qualification: Confirm the described work is a delivered client app and seek a safe test project; claims are self-reported.

leads.name: BuildDigital
leads.observed_evidence: Nexora portfolio page lists a Next.js/React agency dashboard, charts, task boards and WebSocket activity.
leads.next_qualification: Confirm delivered-client status and React router fit; do not promise existing Next.js routing support.

leads.name: Brocoders
leads.observed_evidence: React services include data visualization and link to agency cases; maintains a React boilerplate.
leads.next_qualification: Select a specific recent React browser-app case and ask whether an independent check fills a real gap.

leads.name: Codica
leads.observed_evidence: SaaS service page lists React in its frontend stack and describes custom SaaS delivery.
leads.next_qualification: Verify a named app's actual frontend and recent handover trigger; its own testing may already cover the need.

leads.name: Selleo
leads.observed_evidence: Portfolio tags React on B4B payment management and Breezeway property operations applications.
leads.next_qualification: Check whether current project teams would use external evidence beyond their own QA and engineering.

leads.name: Railsware
leads.observed_evidence: React service page attributes Calendly frontend adoption and parts of Knowa's communication frontend to React.
leads.next_qualification: Sophisticated product engineering is a substitute; qualify a narrow resource-regression gap before pitching.

leads.name: Monterail
leads.observed_evidence: Dalza case describes web React and mobile React Native with document sharing, chat and user roles.
leads.next_qualification: Separate web from mobile; use only safe synthetic healthcare data. Internal QA and scale may make the small offer unsuitable.

leads.name: Brainhub
leads.observed_evidence: Big Four case lists React/TypeScript applications for tax reports, legal entities and complex filtering.
leads.next_qualification: Enterprise access and its own specialists may dominate; evaluate partnership or learning rather than assuming a $300 sale.

leads.name: 10Clouds
leads.observed_evidence: React services describe Quesmed's React web application alongside separate React Native delivery.
leads.next_qualification: Identify one web-app delivery team and actual pain; the firm also provides product/engineering services.

leads.name: Rootstrap
leads.observed_evidence: React page attributes MasterClass payment modernization to React-team work and also mentions task-management delivery.
leads.next_qualification: Confirm a suitable current agency project; do not test real payment flows or assume performance work is missing.

leads.name: GeekyAnts
leads.observed_evidence: Manufacturing asset-management dashboard case explicitly identifies React and data/IoT workflow requirements.
leads.next_qualification: Large clients and existing QA services can complicate access; web dashboard only, excluding mobile and backend capacity.

leads.name: Aimprosoft
leads.observed_evidence: PR.BUSINESS primary case-study PDF describes a React business dashboard for listings, reviews and performance data.
leads.next_qualification: Confirm current agency ownership, relevant project version and existing regression checks.

leads.name: Netguru
leads.observed_evidence: Product-analytics page describes Babbel's React/Rails admin module for user management, invoicing and engagement data.
leads.next_qualification: Established QA/product services and enterprise procurement reduce initial accessibility; useful segment benchmark.

leads.name: Radixweb
leads.observed_evidence: TopDawg technical case describes a React SPA with catalog management, imports and dashboards.
leads.next_qualification: Confirm a smaller appropriate delivery team and a runtime gap; do not infer the public client has a defect.

leads.name: Bitovi
leads.observed_evidence: Yum case says Bitovi built React apps; engagement includes a substantial ordering platform and frontend engineering.
leads.next_qualification: Specialist engineering/consulting is both a possible partner and a direct substitute, not an assumed easy customer.

leads.name: Apptension
leads.observed_evidence: Maintains a React/Django/AWS SaaS boilerplate; portfolio describes SaaS applications including event experiences.
leads.next_qualification: Technology and app evidence come from separate sections; verify React on the exact target case and unmet need.

leads.name: Leobit
leads.observed_evidence: React services and solutions page presents reporting/analytics work among a multi-technology portfolio.
leads.next_qualification: Match an individual React browser app; avoid assigning the stack of one project to every analytics case.

leads.name: The Software House
leads.observed_evidence: React service page links cases and explicitly offers review and enhancement strategy for React applications.
leads.next_qualification: Already sells review services. Could be a benchmark/partner; confirm a specific case and gap before prospect qualification.

leads.name: Nearform
leads.observed_evidence: Work index attaches React tags to several client applications and separately lists supply-chain and quantitative-analysis work.
leads.next_qualification: Read a specific linked case before associating analytics work with React; existing expertise is a strong substitute.

leads.name: hedgehog lab
leads.observed_evidence: Retail-bank case identifies a React/Contentful web build; sustained dashboard use is not established.
leads.next_qualification: Find actual interactive application work, rather than pitching retention checks for a CMS marketing site.

leads.name: Rangle
leads.observed_evidence: Service page offers React/Next.js web apps and complex product engineering; a specific data-heavy case is not established here.
leads.next_qualification: Choose a relevant current case. Broad specialist services make this a benchmark/partner lead first.

leads.name: Miracuves
leads.observed_evidence: React page offers admin panels and dashboards; analytics scenario is labeled an example engagement.
leads.next_qualification: Obtain a real attributable delivered-client portfolio and app scope. An illustrative engagement is not customer proof.

leads.name: Evolvion
leads.observed_evidence: Indexed Front case describes a custom React business dashboard; direct fetch timed out during research.
leads.next_qualification: Reopen and validate the primary case, delivered-client status and real app before counting as portfolio-matched.

leads.name: Digisoft Solution
leads.observed_evidence: Indexed React services mention Gardenova AI admin work; direct page extraction was unavailable.
leads.next_qualification: Read the attributable individual case and confirm React browser delivery; search text alone is insufficient qualification.

leads.name: Pagepro
leads.observed_evidence: Primary Proofed case has a Next.js/React order-management description in an indexed company post; fetched case body was empty.
leads.next_qualification: Reopen case content and confirm exact web workflow/router compatibility; do not rely on metadata alone.

leads.name: Polcode
leads.observed_evidence: Indexed company redesign article mentions React/Next.js, but body extraction was inconsistent; data-heavy case found uses Angular.
leads.next_qualification: Find a React application client case. Its own marketing website and an Angular dashboard do not establish target fit.

leads.name: Codal
leads.observed_evidence: Baxter case describes complex data charts and Highcharts, but browser React delivery is not established.
leads.next_qualification: Confirm a React web-app portfolio first; available chart case emphasizes a mobile app and cannot prove browser fit.
